evidence: Wilson, Flora Checklist of Northamptonshire (2014): Sorbus aucuparia L., Rowan
terms.comment: Linnaeus’s name; the ancient sorbus is the service tree. aucuparia is not in Lewis & Short and is left without marks of length.

sources: Rob Wilson, A Flora Checklist of Northamptonshire & The Soke of Peterborough (2014), on the website of the Botanical Society of Britain and Ireland.
